title: ECP Gateway Load Test

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Authenticated requests/s from middleware histogram _count.

panels.title: Requests in range
panels.description: Total authenticated requests observed in the selected time range.

panels.title: E2E p99
panels.description: 99th percentile end-to-end auth middleware latency.

panels.title: RBAC fetch p99
panels.description: 99th percentile RBAC fetch latency (K8s List when impl=direct; cache read when cached).

panels.title: RSS
panels.description: Sum of process resident memory across selected gateway pods.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Total goroutines across selected gateway pods.

panels.title: Request rate by provider
panels.description: RPS derived from ecp_gateway_auth_middleware_duration_seconds_count.

panels.title: Requests in range by provider
panels.description: Total request count over the dashboard time range (histogram _count increase).

panels.title: Authz and RBAC fetch rate
panels.description: Authorize calls and RBAC data fetches per second.

panels.title: End-to-end latency quantiles
panels.description: Auth middleware duration: authn + authz + provider handler.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, impl) (rate(ecp_gateway_authz_check_duration_seconds_bucket{job="ecp-gateway", component=~"$component", impl=~"$impl"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, impl) (rate(ecp_gateway_authz_check_duration_seconds_bucket{job="ecp-gateway", component=~"$component", impl=~"$impl"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: RBAC fetch p50/p99 by impl (upstream K8s proxy)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, impl) (rate(ecp_gateway_rbac_fetch_duration_seconds_bucket{job="ecp-gateway", component=~"$component", impl=~"$impl"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, impl) (rate(ecp_gateway_rbac_fetch_duration_seconds_bucket{job="ecp-gateway", component=~"$component", impl=~"$impl"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: impl=direct is a K8s List of Role/RoleAssignment; impl=cached is an informer cache read.

panels.title: Mean latency stack (e2e / authz / rbac)
panels.description: Mean latencies from histogram sum/count. Useful to see how much of e2e is authz/fetch under load.

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Allocation pressure under load. High alloc rate often drives GC.

panels.title: Container working set (cAdvisor)
panels.description: cAdvisor working set for gateway containers in namespace ecp.

panels.title: GC CPU time fraction
panels.description: Approx wall time spent in GC per second (summary sum rate).

panels.title: GC pause quantiles
panels.description: go_gc_duration_seconds summary: quantile 0=min, 1=max.

panels.title: Container CPU throttling
panels.description: Non-zero means the pod hits its CPU limit under load.

panels.title: API server request p99 by verb
panels.description: Cluster API server latency (not only gateway traffic).

panels.title: API server request rate by verb
API server request rate by resource (top load)
Gateway RBAC fetch vs API LIST p99
panels.description: Compare gateway-observed direct RBAC List latency with cluster-wide LIST p99.

panels.title: Gateway scrape up
panels.description: up == 0 means Prometheus cannot scrape gateway /metrics.

description: Load-test observation for ECP gateways: request counts/rates (histogram _count), latency under load, memory, GC, process saturation, and upstream Kubernetes (RBAC fetch + API server + cAdvisor).
